change: Original prompts: free-form preference summary and three recommendations; the one-at-a-time version could briefly react before each next question. No shared title-selection procedure.

Add shared selection rules: use the recent favorite as the strongest taste clue, exclude already-seen titles, respect format/time/avoidances, and prefer popular Netflix US titles. Summarize all six answers in a fixed order. Remove reactions between questions in the one-at-a-time format.

Accept vague answers such as idk or whatever without re-asking; choose the three most-famous/most-watched fitting titles. Change the temperature fallback from 0.2 to 0, while retaining an OPENAI_TEMPERATURE override; actual hosted override was not verified.

Give each recommendation a separate role: pick 1 resembles the recent favorite; pick 2 matches genre and mood; pick 3 matches format and available time. Use popularity to break ties. Only 23 chats and 11 complete cross-format pairs were saved.

Propose a fixed ranked title catalog: select a genre list, filter format/seen titles/avoidance tags, then take its first three eligible entries, ignoring mood and time. Rejected and reverted in f21a872 before testing; no score.

Replace the per-pick roles with one main guide: the recent favorite and titles its fans watch next. Copy all six answers into an exact Got it line and choose from that text; retain format/avoidance filters, but ignore mood/time. If no favorite, use genre then general popularity.

Change the selection guide from what fans watch next to titles similar in genre, story, and country/language. Add a fixed Since you liked guide line before the picks and require exact capitalization in the Got it copy. Keep format/avoidance checks and popularity fallback when no favorite is given.

Prioritize titles from the same series, story world, or creators before genre/story matches, with popularity as tie-break. Resolve either or unclear format to the format of the recent favorite. Other Eval 6 instructions remain.

Keep Eval 7 prompts unchanged. Force application temperature to 0 regardless of OPENAI_TEMPERATURE and add seed 368 to model requests. This is an app.js/config.js settings change, not a prompt revision.

Narrow the first-priority choices to sequels/prequels/spin-offs, removing the same-creator shortcut. Add a final check against recommending the recent favorite. When no favorite is given, use popular Netflix original series in the first genre, or overall if no genre is given.

Choose picks 1 and 2 by similarity; make pick 3 another title by the creator/director of pick 1, falling back to the creator/director of pick 2. Also exclude specials/documentaries/behind-the-scenes titles about the recent favorite.

Remove the creator-based third-pick rule and return all three picks to similarity/story-world selection. List all three title lines first, followed by separate unnumbered descriptions, so explanations do not interrupt the title list.

Restrict all recommendations to Netflix originals and simplify selection to similarity plus a popularity tie-break, removing the story-world priority and explicit final self-check. Restore a description immediately under each title. Retain favorite/related-special exclusions and format/avoidance filters.

Write Netflix original plus the selected movies/TV shows format into the fixed guide line. Exclude shows first aired on a TV network. Replace the no-favorite fallback with the top three entries from the official all-time Most Popular English TV list, as a prompt instruction rather than a live lookup.
Keep Eval 13 rules, but replace the popularity tie-break between equally similar Netflix originals with the earlier release date. No other prompt or settings change in this round.

Clarify that a show first aired on a TV network in any country is excluded even if Netflix later streams or labels it an original; add Breaking Bad and Money Heist as examples. Retain Eval 14 earlier-release tie-break and temperature 0/seed 368.

Keep Eval 15 prompts unchanged. Remove seed and restore OPENAI_TEMPERATURE with fallback 0.2; hosted override value was not verified. After testing, revert these settings in 04ac259 to temperature 0 and seed 368.
